entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
I need to start a return.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. I can definitely help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602-PULSE. It's for the VeloBand Pulse.

Got it, VF88602-PULSE. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. Before we proceed, could you tell me, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
There's no issue with it. It was an impulse buy, and I've basically changed my mind. To be honest, I just don't use it. So, can I return it or not?
I understand. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for this item. Please hold for a moment.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your order and our policy. I see it was delivered 42 days ago, and since our return window is 10 days, you are definitely eligible for a full refund. I can process that for you right now.
Oh. Great. What's the next step?

I have just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Simply print it, attach it to the package, and you can drop it off with your local postal carrier. Your refund will be issued once we receive the item.
Yes, that's everything on my end. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
